user.title: Connect to Alula
user.description: Sign in with your Alula account to control your alarm panel.

data_description.username: The email address you use to sign in to the Alula app.
data_description.panel_id: Optional. Only needed if your account has multiple panels. You can find this in the Alula app under device settings.

error.invalid_auth: Invalid email or password. Please check your credentials.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Alula API. Please check your internet connection.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Check the Home Assistant logs for details.

abort.already_configured: This Alula account is already configured.

init.title: Alula update settings
init.description: Live changes from the panel arrive as pushed events. These settings only control how often the integration asks the panel for a refresh. Lower values mean more load on the panel and Alula's servers, which matters most on systems with many zones.

data_description.live_updates: On (default): pushed door/zone events and periodic zone refreshes. Off: the integration only checks arming state and whether the panel is online through Alula's cloud, and opens no WebSocket to the panel (arm/disarm still works on demand). Turn it off to test whether live updates affect your panel's connection.
data_description.zone_refresh_minutes: How often to ask the panel for the status of your programmed zones. Default 10.
data_description.config_rescan_hours: How often to rescan all 64 zone slots to pick up programming changes. Default 6.
data_description.scan_interval: How often to check arming state and whether the panel is online (talks to Alula's cloud only). Default 60.
